minutes.headline: Assessors voted to release the latest Mike-supplied DOR data and the abatement log on request, and approved the town report and wording.
minutes.summary: The Board of Assessors heard the consultant explain commercial, industrial and apartment valuation methods, with preliminary data now under Department of Revenue review. They debated releasing preliminary data and voted to share the latest DOR submission and corrected abatement log by electronic request, not on the website. They also approved the Assessor's annual town report as amended and the wording of the impact statement and public disclosure notice, and set tentative meeting dates.

public_comment.topic: Asked that the Assessor's report, impact statement and public disclosure be made available immediately once approved, and asked when the data and a public meeting would be available.

votes.motion: Release the latest data Mike submitted to the Department of Revenue, plus the abatement log, on request in electronic form with a date on it.
Accept the Assessor's report for the annual town report as amended (program changed to orientation).
Approve the impact statement wording as amended by Miss camer (removing the word significantly, splitting a sentence).
Accept the wording and layout of the public disclosure notice (numbers still to be approved).

budget_items.what_was_said: The MFS report recommended adding at least one part-time person, which will be noted in the town report.
The consultant reported percentage increases by property class, with apartments the largest.
Preliminary numbers were described as an average increase across the town.

budget_items.what_was_said: The idea of a consultant staffing the office during the disclosure week was dismissed as costly and not executable.

The February 15 meeting is dropped; the next meeting is tentatively the 21st, with the 26th, 28th, March 4th and the tax classification session on March 12th noted.
February 21 and March 4 tentatively set as actual meetings; the other dates held in reserve.

what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors voted to release the latest data submitted to the Department of Revenue, plus the abatement log, on request in dated electronic form.
The released data will go out by electronic public records request and will not be posted on the town website.
The board accepted the Assessor's annual town report as amended, and approved the amended impact statement wording.
The board accepted the wording and layout of the public disclosure notice, with the numbers still to be approved.
The board dropped the February 15 meeting, tentatively set February 21 and March 4 as meetings, and held other dates in reserve.

why_it_matters: Residents can get the preliminary valuation data and the abatement log by asking for them, but the board chose not to publish them on the town website.
The disclosure notice and the preliminary values it will carry bear on how property assessments are explained before tax bills are set.
No one will staff the assessor's office for the whole disclosure week, so residents who want to ask about their values may find access limited.
watch_next: Approval of the numbers in the public disclosure notice, which the board left open.
Tentative meetings on February 21 and March 4, and the tax classification session on March 12.
